payload.title: AMENDABLE_FIELDS and AmendedFields hand-mirror the keys of finding-event.schema.json $defs/amended, and no spec pins the TypeScript lists to the schema: T5 pins only the event-type list
evidence: tests/invariants/finding-registry-events.spec.ts:189-232 (T5 pins the event vocabulary, not the amended keys)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept and the tier-3 rule: a list written in three places is derived from one or pinned by a test
payload.notes: A field added to the schema's amended keys (or removed) leaves AMENDABLE_FIELDS and AmendedFields as they were: the converter stops carrying the field, or the types admit a field the schema refuses, and nothing is red until a branch hits it. Close condition: AmendedFields is derived from the AMENDABLE_FIELDS tuple and a spec compares that tuple with the keys of the schema's $defs/amended fields, so adding a key in one place is red until the others follow.
